system.description: Fortified by the certainty that she is in the right, the martial artist draws even more validation from her own greatness. For the remainder of the scene, when she performs Martial Arts stunts, they count as one level higher only for the purposes of regaining Essence or Willpower. This Charm may only be used when the character is fighting for an Intimacy or her Motivation.
system.source: Scroll of the Monk: The Imperfect Lotus
